meta.name: Nischhal Portfolio 2026
meta.description: Evidence-first editorial product-design portfolio: warm neutral surfaces, black editorial typography, orange signal color, product-specific case-study narratives, restrained motion, and an optional Three.js system field that visualizes complexity resolving into structure.

accent.role: focus, active state, key emphasis, selective interaction signal

neutral.usage: Warm neutrals carry nearly all surfaces and text hierarchy; orange is intentionally scarce so it remains meaningful.

surface.elevated: color-mix of page and ink with a subtle border rather than heavy shadow

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast ink on warm neutral surfaces; secondary copy remains clearly darker/lighter than background; orange is never the sole carrier of meaning.

font_families.heading: Arial, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, sans-serif with Georgia italic editorial contrast
font_families.body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Large compressed sans typography provides product-studio confidence; sparse italic serif phrases add editorial personality; mono text is reserved for metadata, not body copy.

spacing.content_density: spacious with intentionally denser project metadata and data-heavy examples
spacing.section_rhythm: Large editorial intervals between narrative chapters, tighter rhythm inside proof, facts, and decision groups.

layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric editorial compositions constrained by a strict grid

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px warm-neutral dividers; round controls only where the control itself benefits
shape.divider_style: 1px solid neutral line with generous surrounding space

elevation.shadow_style: minimal; prefer border, overlap and contrast over card shadows
elevation.depth_cues: overlap, surface contrast, sticky/fixed positioning and the optional WebGL field

iconography.style: simple geometric SVG / text arrow cues
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide-style outline icons when an icon is necessary; avoid emoji and decorative icon noise

motion.entrance_pattern: 20–28px translateY + opacity, decelerating into place; small stagger only for grouped content
motion.exit_pattern: shorter opacity or opacity + slight translation; no theatrical exit choreography
motion.philosophy: Functional editorial motion: motion explains hierarchy and state, never competes with portfolio evidence, and always respects reduced motion.

components.button_style: rectilinear text-forward buttons with strong focus state and restrained hover translation
components.input_style: high-contrast labels, visible boundaries, explicit focus ring, comfortable 44px+ target size
components.card_style: project rows and narrative blocks rather than a wall of rounded cards
components.navigation_pattern: fixed editorial header on desktop, focus-trapped overlay drawer on mobile
components.modal_style: avoid unless required; use lightweight dialogs with explicit close and focus return
components.list_style: editorial rows for projects; compact definition lists for case facts; bullet lists only for evidence or validation
components.component_notes: Every interactive element must be keyboard reachable, have a visible focus state, and preserve meaning with motion disabled.

aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial product studios with restrained modernist grid discipline

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: large type and project evidence carry weight; metadata stays quiet
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal from proposition to flagship work to proof
visual_language.texture_usage: mostly flat; texture comes from typography, real project imagery and the optional generative system field

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast, spatial isolation, editorial grid and scarce accent color
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom narrative with horizontal tension inside project rows
composition.negative_space_role: separates arguments and increases perceived confidence; never used to conceal missing evidence

imagery.photo_treatment: project imagery shown cleanly with minimal decorative framing
imagery.illustration_style: diagrammatic and product-specific rather than generic SaaS illustration
imagery.graphic_elements: numbered rails, orange signal blocks, system-grid field, restrained arrows
imagery.pattern_usage: rare; grid appears as a conceptual system visualization rather than wallpaper
imagery.image_shape: mostly rectangular product frames with limited rounding

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: small color, underline, media translation or 1px press changes
interaction_feel.loading_style: prefer native content loading; no decorative loader unless real latency requires feedback

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: direct, specific, technically literate and human
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: state what is unavailable and provide a useful next step

overview.performance_tier: heavy only on capable desktop devices; otherwise lightweight
overview.fallback_strategy: disable WebGL and scroll motion for reduced-motion, save-data, coarse pointer, small viewport or low-power devices; content remains fully usable as static HTML/CSS
overview.primary_technology: WebGL/Three.js for one hero field plus GSAP/WAAPI for restrained reveal motion

background_effects.description: No perpetual decorative animated background; surfaces remain editorial and calm.

particle_systems.description: 112 points begin scattered and resolve toward an ordered grid as the user moves through the hero, reinforcing the portfolio proposition of turning complexity into structure.

params.movement_pattern: slow ambient drift interpolating from scattered positions to grid targets
params.interaction: subtle pointer tilt and scroll-linked ordering

3d_elements.description: A lightweight points-and-lines system visualization; it is conceptual support, not the primary content.

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer, transparent, antialias, devicePixelRatio capped at 1.5
params.lighting: none required for PointsMaterial and LineBasicMaterial
params.interaction_model: scroll interpolation + subtle pointer rotation; paused when offscreen or document hidden

shader_effects.description: Custom GLSL is intentionally avoided because the conceptual point field does not need shader complexity.

scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: reveal animations are one-shot; product-image parallax is scrubbed

scroll_morphing.description: Hero point field morphs from scattered complexity toward an ordered grid as scroll progresses.

text_effects.description: Typography relies on hierarchy and editorial contrast rather than split-letter spectacle.

image_effects.description: Project media can move a few percent with scroll or a few pixels with fine-pointer hover; imagery remains legible and never distorts.

canvas_drawings.description: The hero canvas renders a restrained system field through Three.js.

params.animation_loop: requestAnimationFrame with visibility and device guards
params.responsiveness: renderer resizes to its figure; DPR capped

svg_animations.description: Project SVG assets remain content, not decorative animation surfaces.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The portfolio deliberately limits advanced effects to one meaningful hero visualization and subtle image motion. WebGL must never be required for navigation, comprehension, project evidence or conversion. Reduced-motion, save-data, low-power-device and viewport guards are part of the design contract, not optional implementation polish.
